author: Kənd Həyatı
description:
Fresh autumn apples from the village orchard mark the beginning of another season of preparing for winter 🍎🍂 In this video, we gather ripe apples and turn the harvest into homemade treats and preserves to enjoy during the colder months.

The fresh fruit is carefully picked, sorted, and prepared using simple traditional methods. From the orchard to the kitchen, every step reflects the peaceful rhythm of autumn village life and the importance of making the most of the seasonal harvest.

Autumn is a special time for harvesting, preserving, and preparing the pantry for winter. Fresh apples, homemade food, and traditional countryside methods come together in a warm celebration of the season. 🍏🌾🏡
title: Autumn Apple Harvest | Preparing for Winter 🍎🍂
